name: Ciarán Walsh
action: He switches off the soldering iron, washes his hands, and walks to the petrol station to meet Aoife.
reason: The direct request from his sister, combined with the memory that she once waited an hour hoping he would come out, outweighs his usual reluctance to interrupt a job. He is unlikely to let her wait again, so he chooses to meet her briefly despite the unfinished solder work.
